BRABU UG 2nd Merit List 2026-30 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Babasahab Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Muzaffaprur (BRABU) has released the 2nd Merit List for the Graduation/ Under Graduate/ Degree Course (B.A, B,.Com, B.Sc) Admission 2026-30 on the official website of the BRABU recently. The applications for BRABU UG Admission 2026 were accepted from 04 May 2026 to 25 May 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their BRABU UG 2nd Merit List 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 May 2026
  • Last Date : 25 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 May 2026
  • 1st Merit List : 12 June 2026
  • 2nd Merit List : 23 June 2026
  • 3rd Merit List : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 300/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
